C0804.title: Over 200 Malicious npm Packages Target Azure Developers in Large-Scale Typosquatting Attack
C0804.summary: In March 2022, JFrog's security research team identified over 200 malicious npm packages designed to typosquat packages within the @azure scope. Attackers created packages with names resembling legitimate Azure packages but stripped of the scope, exploiting developer typos.
